name: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk
summary: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk engages in the IT transportation telematics and systems development activities to passenger and freight transportation industries in Indonesia. The company provides safety fleet management system, public transport and logistic solutions, intelligent traffic control system, Internet of Things (IoT) smart bus, tourism solutions, smart street lighting, digital payment solutions, transit-oriented development, terminal operating system, smart command center, railways monitoring solutions, identification and booking system, maintenance and LiDAR system.
